title: 通胀压力已退：美联储加息，会否逼急英国央行
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think the point that Joe Washmaid, which is very important, I'll apply this to the UK, is he made a key point that, you know, he is looking to see whether I think he used the word trend
segments.zh: 我认为乔·沃什梅德的观点非常重要，我将此应用于英国。他提出了一个关键点，即他正在观察是否使用了“趋势”这个词

segments.en: inflation, but, you know, underlying inflation is going back to target, and I think also over what period of time. And that's our issue as well. You know, we are looking at the second round effects
segments.zh: 通胀，但你知道，潜在通胀正在回归目标，而且我认为还要看时间周期。这也是我们的问题。我们正在观察第二轮效应

segments.en: of the energy shocks. We're looking at the question, you know, do we expect inflation to return to target over what time and is that time and that trend, you know, sustainable and consistent
segments.zh: 能源冲击的影响。我们在考虑，是否预期通胀在何时回归目标，以及该时间和趋势是否可持续且与通胀目标一致

segments.en: with the inflation target. Now, in the UK situation at the moment I would say so far, I think we're seeing quite subdued second round effects. I think we've seen a softening labor
segments.zh: 目前在英国，我认为第二轮效应相当温和。我们看到劳动力市场已经软化了一段时间

segments.en: marketer for some time now. I think the second round effects are at the moment quite subdued, and that's why I've taken the view that I think we can, you know, we can watch this situation for
segments.zh: 我认为目前第二轮效应相当温和，这就是为什么我认为我们可以暂时观察情况，但每次会议我们都必须重新审视

segments.en: the moment, but we have to, every meeting we have, we have to come back to it.
segments.zh: 目前，但每次会议我们都必须重新审视这个问题。

segments.en: How much does it force your hand if the Fed hikes interest rates, which right now the markets are expecting the Fed to do? Does it put pressure on you to match that in some capacity, partly because
segments.zh: 如果美联储加息，市场目前预期如此，这会在多大程度上迫使你采取行动？是否会在某种程度上给你带来压力，部分原因是货币差异，部分原因是资本竞争？

segments.en: of the currency differentials, partly because of this race for capital, is competition for capital?
segments.zh: 部分原因是货币差异，部分原因是资本竞争？

segments.en: Well, I think, I think, I think, sure, much about the point, you know, if the, whatever the Fed does, it will do it based on its remittance and its responsibilities and respect to the US,
segments.zh: 我认为，无论美联储做什么，它都会基于其职责和对美国的责任来行动，并且会出于与美国相关的理由。我们必须做出与英国相关的决定。

segments.en: and it will do it for reasons to do with the US. We will have to take decisions to do with the UK.
segments.zh: 我们必须做出与英国相关的决定。
